Hi Alice,

Thanks for your time today — great discussion framing Globex Retail's multilingual needs across EU and APAC markets. Quick recap and next steps:

- Primary objectives: customer support triage (FR/DE/IT), product Q&A (EN/JA/KO), and localized content generation for marketing (ES/FR).
- Recommended starting models: "redwood/llama2-70b-q4" (best throughput/cost balance for multilingual inference) and "mosaicml/mpt-30b-multilingual" for lower-latency endpoint tests.
- Benchmarks: shared a lightweight benchmark we run for EU languages and APAC; see Drive link and the attached eval summary (model_eval_report_v1.pdf).
- Prompt sets: attached prompt_set_fr_de_ja_ko.csv — these are the seed prompts we'll use for the first quality pass.

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood runs a 48-hour controlled eval on 5k prompt pairs per locale (FR, DE, IT, JA, KO, ES).
2) We provide prompt-set variants and evaluate BLEU/chrF + human spot checks; share a detailed report.
3) Follow-up call to review results and align on Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs.

Can you confirm access for our SRE/SE team to run these tests (we'll need a non-prod API key or a staging tenant)? Also let me know if there are any additional locales we should include.

Attachments: model_eval_report_v1.pdf, prompt_set_fr_de_ja_ko.csv

Thanks,
